note: Single source of truth for physical goods. The website is built from this file and the iOS app decodes it at runtime from the bundle — editing it in two places is how they drift apart.

products.name: Cedar & Smoke
products.blurb: 220g soy wax, cotton wick. Around 50 hours.
products.detail: Cedarwood over woodsmoke and dry stone. Poured in small batches in Yorkshire. Reusable amber glass.

products.name: Night Vetiver
products.blurb: 220g soy wax. Vetiver, iris, cold ash.
products.detail: Made for the hour before sleep. Earthy rather than sweet, and quiet enough to leave burning while you read.

products.name: Löyly Oil
products.blurb: 100ml. Birch and eucalyptus, for the water.
products.detail: A capful in the bucket. Finnish birch with eucalyptus and a little pine tar. Not for skin.

products.name: Cedar Incense
products.detail: Japanese-style, bamboo-free, so it burns without the sharp edge. Same cedar as the candle.

products.name: Stone Diffuser
products.blurb: Cast concrete, ultrasonic. Eight hours, silent.
products.detail: Cast by hand, so no two are identical. One button, no app, no light. Runs eight hours on a fill.

products.name: Room Speaker
products.blurb: Single full-range driver in oiled ash.
products.detail: One driver, no crossover, no seams to buzz. Pairs in a tap and stays paired. Twelve hours a charge. Not rated for sauna heat — use it outside the room.

products.name: Wool Throw
products.detail: Undyed lambswool from a mill that has been running since 1837. Heavy enough to stay put.

products.name: Deep Space Print
products.detail: The waveform of the piece the station is named after, printed on 310gsm cotton rag.

products.name: Weighted Eye Mask
products.detail: Heavy enough to feel, light enough to forget. Mulberry silk, removable strap, washable.

products.name: Cork Roller
products.detail: Portuguese cork, turned solid rather than moulded over foam, so it does not soften with use.

products.name: Catalogue Tee
products.detail: 240gsm organic cotton, boxy cut, printed with the catalogue index. Washes without cracking.

products.name: Studio Sweat
products.detail: Heavy loopback, undyed so the colour is the cotton's own. Ribbed cuffs that hold their shape.

products.name: Sleep Buds
products.detail: 4mm profile, so they sit flush enough to sleep on your side. Ten hours, and they will not wake you.

products.name: Closed-Back Headphones
products.detail: Tuned flat rather than scooped, because ambient music lives in the mids. Every part replaceable.
